root_causes: Rolling Statcast provider exceptions returned an empty DataFrame and ordinary blank features.
Corrupt rolling caches were deleted and silently replaced by a refetch.
FeatureFactory swallowed every configured rolling-provider exception.
Rolling output did not persist source, cutoff, row-count, or content-hash lineage.
repair: Provider exceptions, None, non-DataFrame, missing-date, invalid-date, corrupt-cache, and cache-write failures are terminal.
Corrupt cache bytes are preserved for quarantine and no implicit refetch occurs.
Configured rolling-provider errors propagate out of feature construction.
Successful empty history is explicit and distinct from failure.
Observed and empty rolling blocks bind source kind, target date, maximum strict-prior source date, row count, and strict-prior content SHA-256.
Rich-feature serialization revalidates rolling chronology and lineage.

target-date row excluded from content hash
